messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Sev2: sustained p95 latency regression on hosted-us-west-2 for route /v1/chat (model=rwinf-medium-q8). AlertID=LAT-20260422-7. Observed window 14m, impacted customers=~8, current p95=1.1s. Pager: @oncall

Nina (oncall): Acked. Starting live triage. Pulling graphs, tracing, recent infra changes.

Nina (oncall): Quick timeline: 16:02 anomaly detected, 16:05 spike to p95 ~1.1s, 16:08 deploy-bot rolled kernel image rwinf-kern-20260422-v2 to canary pool, 16:15 autoscaler added 3 pods, 16:20 deploy reached ~60% of west-2 nodes.

Carlos: Any kernel or runtime changes? We had a platform CVE backport earlier today but that shouldn't affect scheduling.

Priya: There was a tuning commit to reduce tick frequency and enable CONFIG_PREEMPT in the image shipped as rwinf-kern-20260422-v2. Intended to improve latency for multi-tenant noisy neighbors.

Tom (eng-plat): Traces show a sharp increase in span service.runtime.attention_loop on affected hosts. Sample trace tr-8a9c: attention_loop=760ms, kernel-futex-wake=180ms, serialize=30ms.

Hannah (sre): Perf counters on a hot pod: context-switches jumped from ~1.2k/min -> ~15k/min; softirq utilization up. Also seeing 'sched_latency' syslog warnings around 16:04.

Yara (ops): I pulled dmesg from a hit node: repeated "sched_lateny: task X delayed by 1200ms" messages. Also see kthread_timeouts.

Nina (oncall): Hypotheses (tracking inline):
- H1: CONFIG_PREEMPT change plus tick tuning introduced scheduler preemption anomalies affecting tight spinning loops in attention kernel. (owner: Priya)
- H2: New kernel backport altered futex/wake paths causing long userland wake latencies. (owner: Tom)
- H3: Packing/affinity change in image caused contention on NMI/IRQ cores -> elevated softirqs (owner: Hannah)

Carlos: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pause further rollout of rwinf-kern-20260422-v2; 2) Drain 6 most-affected nodes and reattach them with previous image; 3) Temporarily enable per-pool CPU isolation (cpu-pinning flag) for serving pods. Approve?

Nina (oncall): Proceed. Yara, execute drains.

Yara (ops): Draining nodes west-2-node-11..16 now (16:34 UTC). Reverting canary nodes to rwinf-kern-20260420 baseline. CPU pinning flag toggle pushed at 16:40.

Nina (oncall): Early measurements: after toggles and drains, cluster p95 fell from 1.1s -> ~640ms at 16:52. p50 mostly stable. Customer feedback via Maya indicates some improvement but intermittent slowness remains for sessions routed to still-on-image nodes.

Tom (eng-plat): Collected perf record on rollback vs patched nodes. flamegraph excerpt: on patched nodes top functions include __schedule and softirq handling consuming ~38% CPU, while on rollback nodes the attention_loop dominates but kernel scheduling overhead is smaller.

Priya: I spun up a staging repro with the exact kernel config. I can reproduce a 2.8x slowdown in the attention microbench when PREEMPT and tick_interval lowered together. When I disable PREEMPT the regression disappears.

Nina (oncall): Noted. Let's add that to hypothesis evidence: PREEMPT+tick tuning reproducible (owner: Priya).

Hannah (sre): Adding traced events: futex_wake latency increased substantially on patched hosts. Collecting perf top + ftrace for wakeups.

Tom (eng-plat): Tracing detail (sample):
```
trace_id=tr-8a9c
  span: attention_loop 760ms
    -> cpu_spin_wait 320ms
    -> futex_wait 200ms
    -> kernel-wakeup 180ms
```
Looks like wait/wakeup handoff path delayed.

Carlos: Given reproducible local test, decision: hold rollout. Need a kernel config rollback (disable PREEMPT) or alternative scheduling parameters. Recommend we build a recovery image rwinf-kern-20260422-hotfix-1 with PREEMPT disabled and redeploy as hotfix.

Priya: I'll prepare the hotfix image and run microbench; ETA 2h. Will include kernel config diff and build logs.

Yara (ops): In parallel I'm continuing to shift traffic away from still-on-image nodes and collecting node-level perf. Current mix p95=560ms (16:58 UTC).

Maya (cust-success): I updated affected customers: explained mitigation steps and promised RCA with timeline. They requested we notify when we have a root cause.

Nina (oncall): Handing off to Carlos for next 2 hours. I'll be reachable on call if needed.

Carlos: Taking lead. Next steps: collect artifact list for RCA -> kernel config diffs, perf captures, ftrace, traces (tr-8a9c + others), node rollout windows, autoscaler logs. We'll assemble a timeline and draft postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident LAT-20260422-7 annotated: mitigated at 1760016800 (17:06 UTC). Follow-up: full RCA + timeline to be posted to #postmortems within 72h.
